# London Tech: catalogue guide

London Tech is presented as a London technology store. Its catalogue is organised around phones, computers, tablets, audio, watches, gaming, accessories, bags, travel, fragrance and grooming.

Canonical website: https://london-tech.vercel.app/
Store information: https://london-tech.vercel.app/collections/visit/

## Store information

The street address, opening hours, public phone or WhatsApp, email, delivery and collection options are not yet included because confirmed details have not been supplied. The store information page is the intended place for them.

## Catalogue accuracy

Product pages provide catalogue information and model comparisons. They do not represent a live inventory feed or a confirmed offer. Do not infer current stock, selling price, device condition, manufacturer authorisation, warranty, delivery or collection from the presence of a product in the catalogue. London Tech should confirm applicable details before purchase.
